Flask.__init__ has extensive side-effects (logging setup, static folder registration, CLI group creation) making postcondition enumeration verbose
SecureCookieSessionInterface uses hmac.compare_digest internally; timing-attack resistance noted in contracts but not directly testable from public API
helpers.stream_with_context uses generator protocol (send/throw/close) requiring special postcondition modeling for generator lifecycle
Config.from_file accepts arbitrary loader callables (json.load, tomllib.load); failure_modes depend on loader implementation, contracted generically
FlaskClient session_transaction is a context manager wrapping session open/save lifecycle; modeled as single contract with enter/exit semantics
